source.name: Adult social care activity in England
source.source: Department of Health and Social Care
source.description: Clients receiving long-term support during the year, across ages 18 to 64 and 65 and over.

source.name: Adult Social Care Outcomes Framework, England
source.source: Department of Health and Social Care
source.description: Social care-related quality-of-life score for local authorities, out of 24.

source.name: Air Quality
source.source: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
source.description: Modelled 2024 annual mean background NO2, PM10 and PM2.5 by local authority, averaged from Defra's 1x1 km PCM maps, with Defra's population-weighted PM2.5.

source.name: EU Referendum Results
source.description: EU referendum results by local authority counting area.

source.name: EU Referendum Results (Constituency Estimates)
source.source: Hanretty, C. (2017). Areal interpolation and the UK's referendum on EU membership. Journal of Elections, Public Opinion and Parties, 27(4), 466-483.
source.description: EU referendum result estimates by Westminster parliamentary constituency.

source.name: Broadband Coverage
source.description: Fixed broadband coverage by local authority district across the UK.

source.name: UK business: activity, size and location
source.description: VAT and/or PAYE based enterprises by local authority district, summed across published broad industries.

source.name: Car Availability
source.description: Cars or vans available to each household, by local authority district for England and Wales (Census 2021). Shares are of households.

source.name: Child Poverty
source.description: Children aged under 16 living in relative low-income families, before housing costs, by local authority across the United Kingdom.

source.name: Claimant Count
source.description: Claimants of Universal Credit and Jobseeker's Allowance by local authority district for Great Britain.

source.name: Council Tax levels in England
source.source: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source.description: Average Band D council tax set by English billing authorities.

source.name: Crime
source.description: Police recorded crime by local authority district for England and Wales.

source.name: Public electric vehicle chargers by local authority
source.description: Publicly available electric-vehicle chargers by local authority.

source.source: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
source.name: Subnational electricity consumption
source.description: Metered electricity consumption by local authority in Great Britain, 2015 to 2024, split between domestic and non-domestic meters and reported in GWh. Domestic meters are counted on both standard and Economy 7 tariffs. The series is restated on 2025 local authority codes; earlier published years are on the boundaries in force at the time and are not included.

source.name: Ethnicity
source.description: Census ethnicity estimates by local authority.

source.name: Fuel Poverty
source.source: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
source.description: Fuel poverty estimates by Lower-layer Super Output Area in England.

source.source: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
source.name: Subnational gas consumption
source.description: Metered gas consumption by local authority in Great Britain, 2015 to 2024, split between domestic and non-domestic meters and reported in GWh. Figures are weather corrected, as the publisher's headline series is, so a cold year is not read as a rise in demand. The series is restated on 2025 local authority codes; earlier published years are on the boundaries in force at the time and are not included.

source.name: General Election Results
source.description: General election results by parliamentary constituency.

source.name: Greenhouse Gas Emissions
source.source: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
source.description: Territorial greenhouse gas emissions by local authority across the United Kingdom, 2005 to 2024, broken down by sector. Aggregated from the published sub-sector and gas detail to a sector total in kt CO2e.

source.name: General Election Results, 1918-2019
source.description: General election results by constituency for every UK general election from 1918 to 2019, aggregated to broad Conservative/Liberal/Labour/Nationalist/Other vote shares.

source.name: Temporary Accommodation
source.source: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source.description: Households in temporary accommodation by English local authority, including households with children.

source.name: House Prices
source.description: Median and mean house prices paid by ward for England and Wales.

source.name: Indices of Multiple Deprivation
source.source: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
source.description: Deprivation scores, ranks and deciles by small area (LSOA) for England.

source.name: Income
source.description: Earnings estimates by local authority of residence for England.

economics/income/table-8/PROV - Home Geography Table 8.5a   Hourly pay - Gross 2025.xlsx#All

source.name: Jobs
source.description: Total jobs by local authority district, 2011 to 2024, on April 2023 codes: employee jobs, self-employment jobs, government-supported trainees and HM Forces, counted at the workplace and rounded to the nearest thousand. Great Britain is complete for every year; Northern Ireland is published for 2020 to 2022 only.

source.name: Land Area
source.description: Standard Area Measurements by local authority district across the UK: land area excluding inland water, alongside the extent of the realm and inland water, in hectares.

source.name: Life Expectancy
source.description: Life expectancy estimates by local area in England, Wales and Northern Ireland; healthy life expectancy estimates across the UK.

source.name: Life Expectancy Series
source.description: Life expectancy at birth for local areas in England, Wales and Northern Ireland, by sex, for every three-year period from 2001 to 2003 onwards, with 95% confidence intervals.

source.name: Local Election Results
source.source: House of Commons Library (2021–2025); Local Elections Archive Project (2016–2019)
source.description: Ward-level local election results for England and Wales. Party votes count each party's highest-polling candidate in a ward, the House of Commons Library's method for vote share in multi-member wards. The 2016–2019 archive has no electorate or turnout, and excludes Scottish STV results. The 2023 workbook has no ward codes, so they are matched by exact name to the ONS May 2023 ward list.

source.name: Local authority revenue expenditure and financing
source.source: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source.description: English local-authority revenue budget estimates; the Atlas map shows total education-services expenditure.

source.name: Mobile Coverage
source.description: 4G and 5G coverage by local authority district across the UK, reported as the share of premises and landmass reached by all four mobile operators and by at least one.

source.name: Housing supply: net additional dwellings
source.source: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source.description: Net additional dwellings by English local authority district.

source.name: NHS Waiting Times
source.description: Referral to treatment waiting times by Integrated Care Board for England.

source.name: Northern Ireland Multiple Deprivation Measure
source.source: Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency
source.description: Deprivation scores, ranks and deciles by super output area for Northern Ireland.

source.name: Planning applications in England
source.source: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source.description: Planning applications received by English local planning authority during 2026 Q1.

source.name: Population
source.description: Ward population estimates.

source.name: Population (Constituency)
source.description: Mid-year usual resident population for Westminster parliamentary constituencies in England and Wales, on the constituencies first contested in July 2024.

source.name: Population (Local Authority)
source.description: UK local authority population estimates by single year of age and sex, mid-2011 to mid-2024.

source.name: Qualifications
source.description: Highest level of qualification breakdown by local authority district for England and Wales (Census 2021).

source.name: Regional gross domestic product: ITL1 regions
source.description: Balanced gross value added at current basic prices and gross domestic product at current market prices, in £ million, for the twelve ITL1 regions and nations, 1998 to 2023. Extracted from tables 1 and 5 of the published workbook, which restates the whole series on January 2025 ITL codes.

source.name: Regional gross domestic product: ITL2 regions
source.description: Balanced gross value added at current basic prices and gross domestic product at current market prices, in £ million, for the forty-six ITL2 regions, 1998 to 2023. Extracted from tables 1 and 5 of the published workbook, which restates the whole series on January 2025 ITL codes.

source.name: Regional gross domestic product: ITL3 regions
source.description: Balanced gross value added at current basic prices and gross domestic product at current market prices, in £ million, for the 182 ITL3 areas, 1998 to 2023. Extracted from tables 1 and 5 of the published workbook, which restates the whole series on January 2025 ITL codes.

source.name: Road Collisions by Local Authority
source.description: Final annual reported road collisions in Great Britain for 2024 and 2025, counted by the local authority DfT assigns each collision to and by the most severe injury the police recorded.

source.name: School Performance (KS4)
source.description: Key Stage 4 performance measures (GCSE results) by local authority district for England, with the 2018/19 to 2024/25 back series.

source.name: School Performance (KS4, Constituency)
source.description: Key Stage 4 performance measures (GCSE results) by Westminster parliamentary constituency for England, on 2024 review boundaries.

source.name: Attainment 8 Gap
source.description: How far non-disadvantaged pupils are ahead of disadvantaged pupils at Key Stage 4, by local authority district for England. Derived from the published disadvantage breakdown as a plain difference in Attainment 8, not the Department's rank-based disadvantage gap index.

source.name: Scottish Index of Multiple Deprivation
source.description: Published deprivation ranks, deciles and quintiles by data zone for Scotland.

source.name: Travel to Work
source.description: How people in employment travel to their place of work, by local authority district for England and Wales (Census 2021). Shares are of people in employment.

source.name: Unemployment
source.description: Model-based unemployment rate estimates by local authority for Great Britain.

source.name: Local authority collected waste management
source.source: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
source.description: Local-authority collected waste in England; collection authorities only to avoid double counting.

source.name: Welsh Index of Multiple Deprivation
source.description: Deprivation scores, ranks and deciles by lower super output area for Wales.

source.name: Workplace income
source.description: Earnings estimates by local authority of workplace for England.
